Its indicator matrix \(W\) is therefore exactly the outer product of two 0-1 vectors (the rows inside the canton but outside the horizontal arm, crossed with the columns inside the canton but outside the vertical arm). Hence \(\operatorname{rank}(W)=1\) for every rasterization. The constant-red background contributes only the additional rank-1 term \(J\), so
\[
M=aJ+(b-a)W
\]

Final answer: 2
